meta.title: The Way to the Music Shop

paragraphs: On Thursday, the club hour was a walk in town. Teacher Kim needed a microphone for the school hall. The music shop in town had one for the school. She gave Leo and Lily a small map and a paper with directions. "Leo, you read the directions," she said, "and Lily, you look at the map." Then she walked behind them to the town.

This is what the paper said. "First, leave the school gate and turn left." "Walk straight on for five minutes." "The bank is on the corner, and you will pass it on your right." "Then you will see a zebra crossing." "Cross the road there, because the police station is opposite the bank." "Turn right at the police station, and walk to the end of the small street." "The music shop is next to the fan shop, and it has a red door."

Leo read the first step, and Lily looked at the map. "Turn left," said Leo. The children walked straight on, and they counted five minutes. A big bank appeared on the corner, and it was on their right. "That is the bank," said Lily. "We are right." They passed the bank and stopped at the zebra crossing. A police officer stood opposite the bank, and he waved to the cars.

The cars stopped, and the children crossed the road. "Is that the police station?" asked Leo. "Yes, it is," said Lily. "Now we turn right, and we walk to the end of the small street." They saw a shop with a big blue fan in the window. "That is the fan shop," said Leo. "The music shop is next to it, and it has a red door." "I can see it," said Lily.

Inside the music shop, a man gave them a long black box. Leo opened the box, and the microphone was inside. "Is it alright if we take it now?" asked Teacher Kim. "Of course," said the man. "The school paid for it last week." Leo carried the box, and Lily held the map. They walked back to the school the same way, and the walk took ten minutes. "Good work, both of you," said Teacher Kim.
